## RegisteredOperation.resourcePlans property

The value plans of the app's resources, which the executor needs to convert references: derived from the app's contract when the operation was registered from one, and empty when it was registered from the manifest alone, so no reference converts.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly resourcePlans: ResourcePlanTable;
```
